notes.title: Scream Fest DLC
notes.notes:
[h2]Trick or Treat![/h2] (if puzzles count as treats)

We are releasing exclusive Halloween-themed puzzles for Steam Scream Fest from October 25 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to November 1 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7). Help us find a way to rid the world of the mysterious pumpkin that is wasting valuable starlight to grow. Worst part–it’s not even edible!

These new levels will take you through a haunted maze and multiple floors of small puzzle segments. The extension will include thematic UI and decorations, a unique spooky soundtrack, and new scary environments.

A mysterious pumpkin plagues the lands of Temple of Starlight. It eats up valuable resources while there is a starlight crisis, which must not go on for long. It seems like it is using up starlight to make... ORANGE! :O

The main mechanic centers around moving the pumpkin and dropping it down to progress. However, you must activate the pumpkin by applying your color blending expertise in order to physically move it. Can you find a way to smash the pumpkin?

The halloween puzzles will eventually be available in the full-game release.
